title: Answer
description:
The house that could not contain him shows what "not of this creation" is set against. The wilderness tent was the commanded copy, not a mistake.

The day's once is real, and the statute that it happen every year is what stops it being final.

The ashes cleansed contact with death, in the flesh. They did not purge the conscience. The unblemished victim and the offered servant have to be the same person as the priest.
